description.value: An exotic animal farm near the north end of Kelowna airport where visitors can get up close with red kangaroos, wallabies, capybaras, an African crested porcupine, parrots, and other animals. Guides provide free treats for hand-feeding the macropods. The farm has unpaved gravel, dirt, and grass pathways and a picnic area, making it a quirky Okanagan roadside stop.

address.value: 5932 Old Vernon Road, Kelowna, BC V1X 7V2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an exotic animal farm attraction in Kelowna featuring kangaroos, wallabies, capybaras, and other animals. The site lists 2026 season hours (March–October), confirming it is open. The address on the website is '5932 Old Vernon Road, Kelowna, BC V1X 7V2' while OSM lists the city as 'Central Okanagan'. The OSM name includes 'Admission' which the website does not use. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities was found on the website pages provided, so all amenity fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Kangaroo Creek Farm Admission' but website uses 'Kangaroo Creek Farm' — the OSM node may represent the admission booth rather than the farm as a whole.
OSM lists city as 'Central Okanagan' but website clearly states 'Kelowna, BC'.
No phone number available; website states they cannot answer the phone and directs all inquiries to email (info@kangaroocreekfarm.com).
Pathways are unpaved (gravel, dirt, grass) — not ideal for cleated cycling shoes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, well-established seasonal tourist attraction on Old Vernon Road in Kelowna. A touring cyclist on the Okanagan route would find it a novel roadside stop, even though no cycling-specific amenities are confirmed.
enrichment_extras.notes: Seasonal operation roughly March through mid-October. Email contact only: info@kangaroocreekfarm.com.

wow_evidence: Hand-feeding kangaroos and capybaras near Kelowna airport — regionally famous, quirky story-at-dinner stop.
blurb: Farm near Kelowna airport where you hand-feed kangaroos, wallabies, and capybaras.
